signal: ASI and the iUG launched Emergence 2026, a new flagship conference for the iMIS community, while iMIS held its 34th-straight G2 Leader run

email.body1:
Timothy, saw ASI launched Emergence 2026 for the iMIS community, on top of iMIS holding its 34th-straight G2 Leader run.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market associations than the team can cover before the message lands everywhere it should. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Timothy, quick follow-up for ASI.

With a new flagship event driving demand, strategic-sales targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ASI needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Timothy, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to other association software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Timothy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and running a new flagship event is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to ASI either way.
